tagline.en_US: Create, organize and search personal tasks through a lightweight web interface. Tasks and settings persist as files, with no external database. The app has no built-in login, so keep it on a trusted network or protect access at your reverse proxy.

description.en_US: Tasks.md is a self-hosted task management board that stores data directly as Markdown files. It allows users to organize cards, lanes, and tags across customizable workflows, with every lane mapped to a folder and every card stored as a file. The application includes light and dark mode support, custom color themes, and the ability to treat subdirectories as distinct projects.
